title: AC1024 physical MATERIAL identity, field, owner and class output proof

source.ownerRoute: NOD ACAD_MATERIAL key -> unique owner DICTIONARY -> three MATERIAL records; each record has one unique owner key.
source.fixturePolicy: Existing physical DWG only. Selector outputs are temporary and removed; no investigation DWG/DXF fixture was added.

implementation.change: Register MATERIAL/AcDbMaterial CLASS metadata using the unique union of selected ACDS, DXF-origin and DWG-origin output handles. Refuse invalid or duplicate source identities. Add a physical AC1024 selector that uses the existing staged-byte inspector and independently reopens ASCII/Binary output to verify all three source identities and graph roles.
implementation.fields: Compare the complete admitted DRW_Material body state, record identity/name/flags, mapped owner, extension-dictionary handle and mapped reactor sequence. For every extension dictionary, compare owner and ordered name/target membership. Require exactly one MATERIAL/AcDbMaterial CLASS row with instanceCount 3.
implementation.admission: All three source records must have complete AC1024 typed semantic fields and raw source bodies. Existing explicit-partial source read policy remains in force; unsupported fields remain refused.

sourceToOutput.identity: Three unique source handles map to three unique staged MATERIAL OBJECTS records and the same identities appear in fresh typed DXF readback.
sourceToOutput.ownerAndKeys: Fresh readback verifies the NOD ACAD_MATERIAL key uniquely maps to the owner dictionary; the owner parent maps to the NOD; each source owner key maps to the same staged MATERIAL identity.
sourceToOutput.references: Fresh typed readback verifies mapped MATERIAL owner, extension-dictionary owner and entries, and reactor order. The writer's existing stage inspector compares body fields and handle roles against the frozen physical source models before publication.
sourceToOutput.classMetadata: Output contains one MATERIAL/AcDbMaterial CLASS row whose instanceCount equals the three emitted source records.
sourceToOutput.outputArtifacts: ASCII and Binary files are read back by the selector and removed afterwards; no persistent output hashes are claimed.
